edge_case_notes: BBC World Service desk staffed partly by African journalists but editorially London-based; published under BBC banner. Question: count as International (publisher origin) or African (desk staffing)?
AJE Africa coverage produced from Doha + Nairobi/Johannesburg bureaus. AJE is qatari-owned but the Africa desk is partly Africa-based. Question: same as BBC Africa.
Reuters has Africa correspondents but editorial control is London/NY. Wire copy. Question: count as International (control) or by-reporter location?
French public radio's Africa service; partly francophone. Edge for the same reasons as BBC/AJE; also raises the English-only filter issue (Senegal coverage in particular).
